subject: DPA execution plan: DocuSign envelope + fallback signer / chaser cadence
messages:
From: Nora Simmons <nora.simmons@globex.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: DPA execution logistics and signer details

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for working with us on the DPA redlines. Our legal team is ready to execute but prefers AdobeSign for audit traceability; that said, we can accept DocuSign if Redwood can guarantee the signatory chain and an embedded subprocessor disclosure page before signature.

Two quick asks before we proceed:
- Can you confirm who at Redwood will be the countersigner (name + title) and whether they are able to sign via DocuSign?
- If our primary signer is out (vacation / PTO), what is your fallback / escalation plan so the envelope doesn't languish? We have a commercial close target next week.

I've attached our current signer list for reference (Globex_Signer_List.xlsx).

Thanks,
Nora Simmons
Sr. Contracts Manager
Globex Corporation
nora.simmons@globex.com

Attachment(s): Globex_Signer_List.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet listing proposed signers and emails)
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Nora Simmons <nora.simmons@globex.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DPA execution logistics and signer details

Hi Nora —

Thanks, and understood on AdobeSign preference. To keep momentum, Redwood can send a DocuSign envelope. Summary of our proposed execution plan below:

- Envelope routing: Globex primary signer -> Redwood Legal countersign (Head of Legal) -> Redwood CEO (only for exceptions)
- Countersigner: Laura Bennett, Head of Legal, Redwood Inference (will countersign via DocuSign)
- Fallback: if Laura is unavailable for >48 hours, envelope will be auto-reassigned to Karthik Iyer (Sales Ops) as delegated signer to avoid hold-ups — Karthik can sign only for routing/acknowledgement; legal confirmation required for substantive changes after execution.
- Security: we will enable SMS OTP on the envelope and include a dedicated subprocessor disclosure page before signature.
- Chaser cadence: 2 business days after sending, then 4 business days, then escalation to Rishi if still unsigned.

I've attached our redlines for your reference (Redwood_DPA_v3_redlines.pdf). Please confirm whether DocuSign is acceptable with the above fallback, and confirm the Globex primary signer (name + email) so we can prepare the envelope.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior AE, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com

Attachment(s): Redwood_DPA_v3_redlines.pdf (PDF with inline redlines)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: internal: DPA signing authority and fallback

Jasmine / Laura —

Quick internal note on authority: I can approve commercial terms and commit to a close but do not have signatory authority for DPAs that contain non-standard data retention exceptions. Laura, can you confirm whether you'd prefer the envelope to route to you first, or if legal can pre-authorize Karthik to accept the envelope in case of vacation? We need a clean delegation path so the customer doesn't stall.

Also, if Globex requires AdobeSign and it's non-negotiable, call that out now so we can engage IT to map audit logs.

Rishi
VP Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 13:40:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: internal: DPA signing authority and fallback

Thanks — confirming legal position:

- I am authorized to countersign standard DPAs on behalf of Redwood Inference.
- If I am unavailable for >48 hours, we will use a delegated-sign workflow in DocuSign to reassign signing to Karthik Iyer (Sales Ops) with a mandatory "legal acknowledgement" checkbox for post-execution review. Karthik's signature will be limited to execution routing — any substantive changes require post-signature legal approval and possible amendment.
- We will include an explicit subprocessor disclosure page as a pre-sign attachment inside the envelope.
- For audit requirements (AdobeSign), we can accept AdobeSign on a case-by-case basis. If Globex categorically requires AdobeSign, please advise ASAP so I can coordinate with our security team.

I'm attaching our simplified authority matrix for reference (authority_matrix.csv).

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Subject: Final: DPA envelope plan + request for primary signer

Hi Nora —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per our internal alignment, here's the plan we will implement if you confirm:

1) We will send a DocuSign envelope (link included) with routing: Mark (Globex primary) -> Laura Bennett (Redwood Legal countersign) -> CEO (conditional; only used for contract exceptions).
2) SMS OTP will be required for external signers.
3) Subprocessor disclosure will be included as the first document in the envelope (customer must initial).
4) Fallback: if Laura is unavailable >48 hours, envelope automatically reassigns to Karthik Iyer with delegated-sign permissions.
5) Chaser cadence from our side: 48 hours, then 96 hours, then escalation to Rishi.

Please confirm the Globex signer for Mark Haines (or provide alternate), and confirm whether DocuSign with the above controls is acceptable. Once you confirm, I'll send the envelope and follow the chaser cadence.
